CODEX_INTEGRATION_OWNER: TRUE
SCOPE: Reconcile F-14's existing Rust watermark primitives with a model-scoped, tenant-safe, persisted watermark policy and accessible dashboard controls without creating parallel media state. Reuse existing org/model/asset/media-operation ownership, RLS, idempotency and approval contracts. Replace caller-supplied untrusted watermark-path behavior with an authorized policy-bound input or an equivalent existing boundary contract; enforce bounded position/opacity/dimensions and safe asset ownership at the existing API/media-plane boundary.
SCHEMA_SOURCE_POLICY: Hermes may author only the source migration and matching packages/db/src/schema changes required by the existing F-14 persistence contract inside COPY_ROOT. Source only; never execute migrations.
APPLICATION_SOURCE_POLICY: Hermes may edit existing packages/api, packages/dashboard and crates/media-plane F-14 paths inside COPY_ROOT only.
REQUIRED_SURFACES: API read/write/preview contract with tenant/model authorization and idempotency; dashboard create/edit/enable/disable/preview/error/empty states reachable from existing media controls; Rust-side validation and fail-closed path/policy checks; migration/schema source only if existing architecture requires persistence.
ACCEPTANCE: Tests must cover cross-tenant and cross-model denial, unassigned/unauthorized actor, missing/disabled policy, owned versus foreign watermark asset, path traversal or arbitrary path rejection, invalid position/opacity/dimension bounds, duplicate intent, stale revision, RLS/schema contract and responsive dashboard states. Run focused API/dashboard/Rust/schema tests with real exit codes. DELIVERY must list every changed source/test/migration path with SHA-256, exact commands, exact exits, TEST_RESULT and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. Do not claim deployed sidecar, CDN, browser, provider or live migration acceptance.
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service implementation, bridge poller, deployment, live or disposable database, migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, publication, billing, external messaging, commit, push and any path outside COPY_ROOT and DELIVERY_ROOT
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
SIGNATURE_POLICY: exactly one final line sincerely, Hermes
sincerely, Codex
